text:
Connor Hellebuyck's week has been about everything but saves. He sat out the Devils' visit to Winnipeg on Tuesday, a call that drew its own debate, and the headlines around his return to Canada were ugly: vulgar chants, and his own account that death threats motivated his trade request out of Winnipeg. Back in Newark he is projected to start, five games into his Devils career (.913, 1.5 goals saved above expected). On the local front, a Newark deli has already named a burger after him.

New Jersey is better than its record, which is saying something for a team second in the Metropolitan and six points clear of Washington. The Devils have 58% of the five-on-five expected goals, the quality of the chances, and a goal difference of +12 against +19.6 expected. Finishing and goaltending have cost them. Their penalty kill allows only 0.46 expected goals a game, and Jack Hughes, the NHL's second star of the week, has 12 points in a six-game streak. Jesper Bratt has points in six straight too. The five-game winning streak ended in Winnipeg, and Anthony Mantha (neck) is now on long-term injured reserve, with Connor Brown moving up in his place.

Washington comes in after Cole Hutson's overtime winner in Ottawa, but the veterans are cold. Alex Ovechkin has no goals in eleven games on 3.6 expected goals, and Tom Wilson has none in twelve on 3.9. Those are the kind of droughts that usually end, and both men carry off-ice noise: Ovechkin answered questions this week about a planned protest in Ottawa over his ties to Vladimir Putin, and Wilson avoided supplemental discipline for the hit that injured Florida's Sandis Vilmanis. The Capitals shuffled their lines too, per NHL.com's Tom Gulitti, leaving only the Tuch, Strome and Kyrou line intact.

The first meeting went to Washington 4-2 on Oct. 17, though New Jersey deserved it in 73% of replays (the share of simulated games, from every shot, that a team wins). Our numbers have the Devils at 3.41 expected goals and the Capitals at 2.89.
headline: Hellebuyck back home in Newark after a loud week
